verdict.rationale: Brex's developer docs show virtual cards being created in bulk, and limits being set, through its own API connectors on Pipedream and Workato. This implies the public API can issue cards, but the pack contains no Cards API reference. Locking cards and updating card controls are not evidenced, and the MCP server only mentions checking cards. Missing for 10: first-party Cards API reference documentation, card-level limit setting on create, lock/unlock or terminate endpoints, update-controls endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can issue and manage cards programmatically — create a card with a limit, lock it, update controls — via the public API

citations.quote: we’ll show you how to bulk create virtual cards for your employees
Brex integrates with to enable various use cases including bulk creating users, setting monthly limits for users, issuing virtual cards, and sending vendor payments.
